## portcheck browser install

Register portcheck with your browsers

### Synopsis

Register portcheck as the native messaging host for the portcheck extension,
in every supported browser installed for this user (or those given with
--browser). Run it again after moving the portcheck binary.

```
portcheck browser install [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --browser strings        browsers to register with: chrome, edge, chromium, brave (default: those installed)
      --extension-id strings   also allow these extension IDs (e.g. a development build)
  -h, --help                   help for install
      --path string            portcheck binary to register (default: this one)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json                shorthand for --output json
      --log-format string   log format: text or json (default "text")
      --no-color            disable colors (also honors NO_COLOR)
  -o, --output string       output format: table, plain, csv, json (default: table on a terminal, plain otherwise)
  -v, --verbose             log diagnostic details to stderr
```
